license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so this code and these weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. Parts of the LibreYOLO port are derived from Apache-2.0 projects and keep that license; their notices are retained in libreyolo/models/gtr/NOTICE. Apache-2.0 is also permissive: redistributing that code means keeping its license text and notices, and it grants a patent license.
